 In 1993, ‘Believe’ singer Cher paid $1.5 million for a Miami Beach mansion; three years later, she sold it for $4.35 million, nearly triple her purchase price
 SECTIONS In 1993, ‘Believe’ singer Cher paid $1.5 million for a Miami Beach mansion; three years later, she sold it for $4.35 million, nearly triple her purchase price By Team Global , Global Desk Last Updated: Oct 21, 2026, 04:10:00 PM IST Rate Story Follow us Share Font Size Abc Small Abc Medium Abc Large Save Print Comment Synopsis Cher's iconic Miami Beach mansion, originally acquired for $1.5 million, experienced remarkable appreciation, selling for $4.35 million just three years later. By 2020, it re-entered the market and fetched a staggering $17 million, following several attempts at higher listings. This transformation exemplifies the allure of celebrity homes, whose unique charm and history make them attractive investment assets.
 Cher, the singer later owned a waterfront mansion on Miami Beach’s La Gorce Island, which she bought in 1993 and sold three years later for nearly triple the purchase price (Image credit: Wikimedia Commons)
 Some homes attract attention because of their architecture, location, or history before any major changes are made. In Miami Beach , where properties offer opportunities for peace and indulgence, Cher was able to locate the ideal mansion. The house sat on an island, overlooked the water, and had a presence that made it more than a place to sleep. It was a retreat, a stage, and a piece of real estate with a personality.
 How Cher turned a Miami Beach mansion into a fast-gaining asset 
Cher purchased the La Gorce Island property for $1.5 million in 1993 and sold it for $4.35 million in 1996, according to property records. According to a Los Angeles Times report, the property once again made news in 2020 after it was sold at $17 million, although it had been listed at $22 million and reduced to $20 million. The waterfront property featured multiple bedrooms, bathrooms, outdoor spaces, a pool, and private access to the water. 
 A home that carried Cher’s taste 
The house of Cher was chosen by her, and the look of the mansion matched her expectations of comfort along with a dramatic touch. The house had rich architecture with arches and tiles, relatively spacious and well-lit living zones, and peculiar interior design solutions. Being situated among numerous luxurious buildings, La Gorce Island provides a sense of identity and comfort that matters as much as the actual size of whatever building.
 Live Events
 To maintain its charm, the house features an elegant entrance with twin staircases drawing people in and leading them into the house designed for socializing or privacy. The internal layout displays a great variety of rooms suitable for both entertaining guests and daily household needs, such as a wet bar, game room, office, and gym. The layout connected indoor spaces with the surrounding waterfront setting, a feature that added to the appeal of properties on La Gorce Island, one of Miami Beach’s established waterfront communities.
 Why the sale price stands out 
 La Gorce Country Club in Miami Beach reflects the upscale surroundings of the area where Cher owned a waterfront mansion in the 1990s (Image credit: Wikimedia Commons)
 The market could just be better with the change of ownership. Even if the sale price is very high, the real earnings for the homeowner could be much less after accounting for all the costs involved. A large home might seem like an excellent buy on paper but still need a lot of money to maintain. This is why the homes of rich and famous people seem to get so much interest. Their purchase and selling prices are public, but the costs along the way may not be known. Public sale records reveal purchase prices, but they do not always show the complete cost of ownership.
 How luxury properties change hands over time 
The property was initially listed at $22 million before the asking price was reduced to $20 million. The point worth noting from this example is that the advertised price does not have to be a set one.
On the other hand, it should be mentioned that the unique identity of the home is not created only by one person. Cher brought her own uniqueness to the place at an early stage. The home's waterfront location, size, and setting likely contributed to its continued appeal among luxury buyers. In this case, the house owned by the celebrities might become a property from private use to a commercial investment object and back to prestige once again. The mansion’s story continued after the 2020 transaction. After further changes to the property, it returned to the luxury market again, showing how high-value estates can undergo multiple ownership and design phases over time.
